name: data_assets_tool
description: Data tool - Manage Webflow site assets via the Data API. Generates asset metadata entries and returns presigned S3 upload information (uploadUrl and uploadDetails) used to upload the file bytes.

label.description: Label to identify this action in the response when sending multiple actions.

file_name.description: File name including file extension. Must be less than 100 characters.

parent_folder.description: Optional asset folder ID to place the asset in.

create_asset.description: Create an asset metadata entry for a site. Generates a response with the following information: uploadUrl and uploadDetails. The uploadDetails props are used as form fields in a multipart/form-data POST request to Amazon S3 (uploadUrl) to complete the upload of the actual file bytes. For code examples (Node, Python, curl) read the MCP resource webflow://guides/asset-upload.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
